name: EUV lithography scanners
summary: The machines that print the smallest features on every leading-edge chip. ASML is the only company that makes them.
what_it_does:
An EUV (extreme ultraviolet) scanner shines very short-wavelength light through a patterned mask onto a silicon wafer, printing the tiniest features of a chip. Shorter light means smaller features, and smaller features mean faster, more efficient chips.

Every leading-edge logic chip and the newest memory depend on EUV. One company, ASML in the Netherlands, builds these machines, using parts from a deep network of specialist suppliers.
